verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a merchant payments and POS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows external-agent integration: a managed MCP server, an Agent Toolkit for LangChain, AI SDK and OpenAI Agents, and LLM-friendly docs. Those let outside assistants call SumUp, but nothing shows an AI assistant built into SumUp's own product that users can delegate tasks to.
